entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just connect me to a person already!
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back now.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF-8675309. And don't give me the runaround.

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 26th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band?

The issue is that it's ridiculously **hard to use**! The interface is so **confusing**, nothing makes sense. I read the **user manual** twice and it's completely useless. Frankly, I **expected more** from a VeloFit product. It's a terrible design.
I understand your frustration, and I'm very sorry the device isn't meeting your expectations. Let me just quickly review our return policy for you.
You'd better be quick. I don't have all day. If I don't get a refund, I'm blasting your company on social media. Maybe I should just talk to your manager right now and save us both the time.

That won't be necessary, sir. I've just checked the policy. I see you received the item 12 days ago, and our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So, you're well within that timeframe.
Oh. Well, fine. That's what should happen. About time.
Of course. I've gone ahead and initiated the return for you. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the item in its original box and drop it off.
Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Alright. Just make sure that email actually shows up.
It has just been sent, Mark. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
